overview: Short underground shoot systems with storage leaves and strong seasonality, dormancy, and renewal biology.
recommended_workflow: Prioritize developmental TF, hormone-related, and storage-transition modules; compare dormancy, sprouting, and renewal stages.
suggested_validation_focus: dormancy and sprouting-stage expression analysis followed by candidate perturbation

overview: Compact underground stem storage organs associated with survival, regrowth, and seasonal redevelopment.
recommended_workflow: Start from stress-resilience, hormone-related, and developmental modules; compare storage-organ redevelopment and stress recovery stages.
suggested_validation_focus: corm redevelopment and stress-recovery expression profiling

overview: Underground horizontal stems involved in clonal propagation, perennial persistence, bud-based renewal, and regrowth after stress or disturbance.
recommended_workflow: Start with meristem/regrowth and cell-wall remodeling modules; compare initiation and elongation stages; prioritize bud activation and rhizome-tip expression profiles.
suggested_validation_focus: bud activation/regrowth-stage expression analysis followed by perturbation in rhizome-capable systems

overview: Basal crown region containing buds and regenerative tissues important for perennial survival and post-disturbance regrowth.
recommended_workflow: Prioritize meristem/regrowth and stress-resilience modules; focus on crown bud activation and post-disturbance regrowth assays.
suggested_validation_focus: root-crown bud activation and regrowth phenotyping

overview: Horizontal stems that can support clonal spread and new ramet formation, sometimes aboveground or shallowly underground.
recommended_workflow: Start with developmental TF and cell-wall remodeling modules; compare stolon initiation, elongation, and node-based establishment.
suggested_validation_focus: stolon initiation and elongation expression analysis followed by targeted perturbation

overview: Thickened roots specialized for storage, regrowth, and stress buffering in crop and wild systems.
recommended_workflow: Focus on hormone-related regulation, cell-wall remodeling, and stress-resilience modules; compare early thickening versus mature storage stages.
suggested_validation_focus: storage-root thickening-stage expression analysis and candidate perturbation

overview: Swollen storage organs associated with carbohydrate accumulation, dormancy, sprouting, and developmental transitions.
recommended_workflow: Prioritize hormone-related regulation, cell-wall remodeling, and developmental TF modules; compare tuber initiation, expansion, and dormancy stages.
suggested_validation_focus: tuber initiation and expansion expression profiling followed by perturbation in tuber-bearing systems
